metadata.description: A prompt-coaching plugin that enhances rough drafts into strong, domain-aware prompts.

plugins.name: claude-prompter
plugins.description: Type /cp or /claude-prompt with a rough idea and get back a polished, domain-aware prompt. Includes a template library (/cp-templates), a proactive prompt-coach skill, clarifying questions only when essential, and the option to save prompts to a personal library.
